Primary Care Progress Note
Date: 07/08/2026
Patient: Johnathon Kemmer, 69 y/o M

CC: Back pain

HPI: Back pain since 07/05/2026 after lifting a laundry basket. No radicular sx. No bowel/bladder changes.

PE: Tenderness over lumbar paraspinals. No step-offs or deformities noted. Neuro exam intact.

Assessment: Acute mechanical back pain.

Plan: NSAIDs prn, activity as tolerated, follow-up prn worsening or new sx.

notes.title: Radiology Report
notes.author: Radiologist
notes.text:
Radiology Report
Date: 08/31/2026
Patient: Johnathon Kemmer, 69 y/o M

Indication: Evaluation of lumbar spine.

Findings:
MRI 08/31/2026: L3 compression fx, marrow edema on STIR.
No other acute fractures or lesions identified.
Intervertebral discs show mild desiccation at L4-L5.
No significant canal stenosis or neural foraminal narrowing.
Paraspinal soft tissues unremarkable.

Impression:
L3 compression fracture with marrow edema consistent with acute/subacute injury.
No additional acute abnormalities detected.

notes.text:
Spine Intervention Consultation
Date: 09/05/2026
Patient: Johnathon Kemmer, 69 y/o M

HPI: Outpt, not admitted. NRS 7/10 despite 8 wks NSM (acetaminophen and tramadol, TLSO brace). Pain worse x2 wks despite brace. Pain at fx level; afebrile, no infx signs.

Assessment: Persistent pain at vertebral fracture site despite conservative management. No signs of infection.

Plan: Referred for DEXA + osteoporosis program. Consider interventional options if pain persists or worsens.
